title: Feature request - settings for Bluetooth devices
symptom: The thread discusses a feature request to split the selection of Bluetooth device entries (e.g., bluereader, limitter, bluecon, sweetreader) in settings. The author notes that current automatic detection can cause problems later, such as special settings only being applied after a successful connection, and checks depending on connection status.
evidence_quote: I would like to discuss to split the selection of the bluetooth device entry for bluereader, limitter, bluecon, sweetreader and so on.
